Brazilian Room Berkeley DJ Wedding Ceremony & Reception DJ May 17, 2014

Brazilain Room Wedding DJ Tilden Park, East Bay.
Name: Jessica Lee

Event: Wedding
Location: Brazilian Room Berkeley,CA.
Guests: 120
Date: Saturday, May 17, 2014
Times: 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM

Time Title
9:00:00 Wedding Party arrive
9:15:00 Guest table / Sign in table setups
9:30~10:15 Wedding party photos
10:30:00-10:50 Ceremony takes place
10:50~11:30 Bar opens/pass drinks/hors d’oeuvres
11:40:00 Ask guests to be seated and open buffet
11:45:00 Wedding Party to be introduced
12:30:00 Toasts with Champagne
1:00:00 Father-Daughter dance
1:05:00 Mother-Son dance
1:10:00 Bride and Groom dance
1:10~1:30 Dancing
1:30:00 Cake Cutting
1:45:00 Bouquet toss
1:50:00 Garter toss
1:50~3:00 Dancing
3:00:00 Guest leaves

theme Song title Artist
Music for the Groom Entrance
rhythm of love – instrumental Plain white T
Music for the wedding part entrance Somewhere over the rainbow/simple gifts The Piano Guys
Music for the bride entrace A thousand years The Piano Guys
Bride and Groom Exit song Best day of my life American Authors

nice and soft in the background
Announcement when it’s ready and ask for 2-3 tables of people at a time
Theme Music title Artist
Music for announcing the wedding part The Rocky theme song
Music for Toasting AFTER Lunch
Music for Bouquet Toss Single Ladies(put a ring on it) Beyonce
Music for Garter Toss Sexyback Justin Timberlake
Music for Cake Cutting Love Story Taylor Swift
Music for 1st dance – Bride /Groom Inevitable Anberlin
Music for 2nd dance – Father/ Daughter My Girl The Temptations
Music for 3rd dance – Mother/Son A song for mama boys to men

Bridesmaid and Groomsmen

Julie Sagusay and Gurvir Sidhu
Savahana Garcia and Adam Mazzotti
Ashley Eagleson and John Michael Renteria II
Karen “Pei Pei” Shu and Ruben Rodriguez

Bride and Groom
Dr. and Mrs. Viscarra
